carpet.rule.zoneguard.name: zoneguard
carpet.rule.zoneguard.desc: Disables observers inside the cubic regions configured with /zoneguard. Turning the rule off restores observers in those regions.
carpet.rule.goldenCarrotCompost.name: Golden Carrot Composting
carpet.rule.goldenCarrotCompost.desc: While enabled, right-clicking a composter while holding a golden carrot composts it with 100% chance, exactly like a regular compostable item.
carpet.rule.snowyCalcite.name: Snowy Calcite
carpet.rule.snowyCalcite.desc: While enabled, stone/cobblestone produced by lava+water generators in snowy (snow-precipitating) biomes becomes calcite.
carpet.rule.noEndPortalTeleport.name: No End Portal Teleport
carpet.rule.noEndPortalTeleport.desc: Enables the /playerNoEndPortalTeleport list management. The rule itself does not change teleporting: only players added to the blacklist (or with globalMode enabled) are not teleported by end portals; non-player entities are unaffected.
carpet.rule.terracottaUncolor.name: Terracotta Uncolor
carpet.rule.terracottaUncolor.desc: While enabled, the stonecutter can revert all 16 dyed terracotta to plain terracotta and all 16 glazed terracotta to their dyed terracotta; while disabled, these recipes do not appear in the stonecutter at all.
globalMode [true|false] - view/set global mode (true = no player is teleported by end portals)
add <player> - add an online player to the no-teleport list
remove <player> - remove a player from the list
playerNoEndPortalTeleport.commands.add.s: Added %s to the end portal no-teleport list.
playerNoEndPortalTeleport.commands.globa: Global mode enabled: no player will be teleported by end portals.
Global mode disabled: only listed players are not teleported by end portals.
haoaddition.rule.exampleBoolean.name: Example Boolean
haoaddition.rule.exampleBoolean.desc: An example boolean rule of this extension.
haoaddition.rule.exampleString.name: Example String
haoaddition.rule.exampleString.desc: An example string rule with a few preset options.
zoneguard.commands.view.empty: There are no configured detector-disabled regions yet.
zoneguard.commands.help.line.set: /zoneguard set <id> <from> <to> - set a cubic region from two opposite corners
zoneguard.commands.help.line.clear: /zoneguard clear <id> - clear a region and restart its observers
zoneguard.commands.help.line.op: /zoneguard op add|remove|list <player> - manage the ZoneGuard operator whitelist
zoneguard.commands.help.line.off: /carpet zoneguard false - disable the rule (command hides, observers recover)
zoneguard.commands.clear.success: Cleared region %s: %s [%s] -> [%s]; restarted %s face-to-face observer pair(s).
